claims.statement: This repository is the trace log of a question-answering agent that answers questions about a fictional bank, Meridian Harbor Financial Corp., using a separate semantic wiki, rather than being application source code itself.

As of this writing, sessions/ contains no session folders or turn-NNNN.md files; it holds only a placeholder sessions/.gitkeep, so no Session, Turn, Decision, ToolCall, SourceReference, Topic, OpenQuestion, or UserIntent pages have yet been generated from real trace data.
